questions.stem: How can a greenhouse be used to overcome limiting factors and increase crop yields?

options.text: By blocking all sunlight to reduce water loss
By adding artificial light, heaters, and CO2 generators to optimise conditions
By removing all oxygen from the greenhouse
By keeping the temperature as low as possible

questions.explanation: Greenhouses allow farmers to control light, temperature, and carbon dioxide levels to optimise conditions for photosynthesis and maximise crop growth.
